types.name: Knowledge Base Entity
types.description: Anything in the Knowledge Base: the base type of its items, and the type of those of no other kind.

types.name: Person
types.description: A person, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Organisation
types.description: An organisation, such as a company, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Organisational Unit
types.description: A part of an organisation, such as a department, in the Knowledge Base (X.500's organizationalUnit).

types.name: Place
types.description: A place, such as a country, locality, or address, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Group
types.description: A group of people, in the Knowledge Base.
